steps: Apply free on dataannotation.tech and complete the ~60-minute starter assessment.
Get matched to projects in your expertise tier.
Complete hourly AI-training tasks on your own schedule.
Receive per-task payments processed weekly to PayPal after approval.
timing: Official: 'Payment is per-task, processed weekly, starting at $25+/hour.'
who_pays: Data Annotation pays you directly per task at your project's hourly tier (generalist $25-$35/hr; coding/STEM/professional tiers $50-$100+/hr).
who_qualifies: Apply free and pass the strict ~60-minute starter assessment - Data Annotation says not everyone gets in. You qualify for project tiers by demonstrated expertise.
work_available: Project-based work with no minimum or guaranteed hours; project availability varies and waitlists are common.
what_gets_accepted: Completed tasks approved for payment. Payment is per-task and processed after approval.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No upfront fee. The ~60-minute starter assessment is unpaid. This is independent-contractor work with no benefits, and payments flow after approval.
when_cash_arrives: Per-task payments are processed weekly to your PayPal account after approval.
